newsitem.title: USA: White House has nothing to confirm Yeltsin rumors.
newsitem.headline: White House has nothing to confirm Yeltsin rumors.

text.p: The White House said it had no information to confirm financial market rumors that Russian President Boris Yeltsin had died.
"Our government has no indication that there's anything to those rumors," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.
At the State Department, spokesman Nicholas Burns said the rumors that Yeltsin had died were wrong.

Burns said the United States had checked the rumors with the Russian government through the U.S. ambassador in Moscow, Thomas Pickering. "These rumors are totally unfounded, they are untrue and there is no basis for them," Burns said.
